about: Plain-English scenarios with the direction any sound mapping must give. A sector without its own shock is judged by its region's stock shock, the way the engine applies it.

cases.text: Interest rates rise by 2 percentage points
cases.why: Bond prices fall when yields rise.
Oil and gas producers earn more when oil is dear.
The companies behind AI are in the technology sector.

cases.text: The US enters a deep recession
cases.why: Earnings fall in a recession, and US stocks with them.
Dollar weakness lifts foreign assets in dollar terms.

cases.text: The Fed cuts rates to zero
cases.why: Bond prices rise when yields fall.
